definitions.explanation: The player at bat in baseball, attempting to hit the pitched ball.

examples.japanese: {次|つぎ}の{打者|だしゃ}が{打席|だせき}に{入|はい}った。
examples.english: The next batter stepped up to the plate.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はチームの{四番|よんばん}{打者|だしゃ}だ。
examples.english: He is the team's cleanup hitter (fourth batter).

examples.japanese: {代|だい}{打|う}ち{打者|だしゃ}が{送|おく}られた。
examples.english: A pinch hitter was sent in.

notes:
ALTERNATIVE TERMS:
・バッター (batter - loanword)
・{打|う}ち{手|て} (hitter - less common)

BATTING ORDER POSITIONS:
・{一番|いちばん}{打者|だしゃ} (leadoff hitter) - typically fast, high on-base percentage
・{二番|にばん}{打者|だしゃ} (second batter) - good bat control
・{三番|さんばん}{打者|だしゃ} (third batter) - best all-around hitter
・{四番|よんばん}{打者|だしゃ} (cleanup hitter) - power hitter

TYPES OF HITTERS:
・{強打者|きょうだしゃ} (power hitter)
・{好打者|こうだしゃ} (good hitter)
・{代打|だいだ} (pinch hitter)
・{指名打者|しめいだしゃ}/DH (designated hitter)

KEY STATISTICS:
・{打率|だりつ} (batting average)
・{打点|だてん} (RBI - runs batted in)
・{本塁打|ほんるいだ} (home run)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{打者|だしゃ}を{打|う}ち{取|と}る (to get the batter out)
・{打者|だしゃ}が{三振|さんしん}する (batter strikes out)
・{打者|だしゃ}を{敬遠|けいえん}する (to intentionally walk the batter)
